fieldDocs.description:
Approves a bar. `bar` is a subject: the request names the row by id and version, and the method gets the row
as it is stored. The rules hold before the method runs.
fieldDocs.name: approveBar

paramDocs.description: whether to notify the bar's owner
paramDocs.name: notify

fieldDocs.description: Approves several bars at once. All of them are approved, or none is.
fieldDocs.name: approveBars

fieldDocs.description:
Quotes a bar that may not be saved yet. `draft` is input rather than a subject: marked `@Input`, it takes
the values the user is editing, and no row is loaded.
fieldDocs.name: quoteBar

paramDocs.description: the bar as the user is editing it
paramDocs.name: draft

description: What approving a bar answers with.

fieldDocs.description: Name of the approved bar, as it was stored when the action ran
fieldDocs.name: name
